DE:
Du spazierst aber noch spät in
der Gegend herum, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:000A:000B:1009001100CD}}

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Este tiempo es de ensueño...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} 
Podría pasarme el día entero
empapada de lluvia, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
Es bueno para purificar el cuerpo.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡A ti no te vendría mal!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Oh, il fait vraiment un temps
magnifique...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Toute cette pluie,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
La pluie c'est bon pour la peau, tu
sais.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} L'eau ça hydrate, bien sûr...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
et ça purifie.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}When it rains, I feel like I could
just swim up into the sky,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}It's SO soothing.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Cuando llueve, siento que podría
nadar hasta el cielo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Quand il pleut comme ça, j'ai envie
de bondir très haut pour nager dans
le ciel, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ah... nager...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Quando piove, il mio cuore salta
di gioia... E io salto nel fango!
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Che bellezza. {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yağmur yağınca gökyüzüne doğru
yüzebilirmişim gibi hissediyorum,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Öyle huzur verici ki.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Is it going to rain all day? {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}I may as
well just stay inside, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tu penses qu'il va pleuvoir toute la
journée, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Je ferais mieux de rentrer me
mettre au sec tout de suite alors,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wenn dieses impertinente Wetter
den ganzen Tag anhält, kann ich
genauso gut auch drinnenbleiben.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bütün gün yağacak mı? {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Ben en iyisi
içeride kalayım, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Our town is getting so muddy in
all this rain. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I don't want to be the
one to clean it up, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Los caminos están totalmente
embarrados. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Pues no voy a ser
yo la que los limpie, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh là là ! Et toute cette boue
partout...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Ne comptez pas sur moi
pour nettoyer après, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}La città si sta riempiendo di fango
con tutta questa pioggia.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Non sarò
di certo io a pulire, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bunca yağmurda kasabamız çamur içinde
kalıyor. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Temizleyen kişi ben olmak
istemiyorum, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ça ne te dérange pas, toi, toute
cette pluie ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Moi je vais vite rentrer
me mettre à l'abri, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Non ti dà fastidio tutta questa
pioggia?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Beh, alla tua età neanche
a me dava fastidio, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Stört dich der Regen auch?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Da will
man sich verbarrikadieren und auf
die Sonne warten,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bunca yağmur seni rahatsız etmiyor
mu?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}İçeri koşup geçmesini bekleyesim
geliyor, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}No me gusta la lluvia, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}pero
reconozco que por la noche
es muy agradable, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quand il pleut la nuit, cela crée une
atmosphère romantique, presque
féerique.
Enfin, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}vu par la fenêtre bien au sec
depuis son fauteuil, bien sûr,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Di notte, la pioggia è quasi
tollerabile.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Preferibilmente a casa,
sotto le coperte, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nachts ist dieser Regen eigentlich
sehr schön.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Da stört er mich gar
nicht so, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gece olunca bu yağmur oldukça güzel
görünüyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}O kadar
da rahatsız etmiyor.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Comment arrives-tu à supporter
toute cette pluie ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Espérons que
cela cesse bientôt, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma tu riesci a sopportare tutta
quest'acqua?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} A me di notte non dà
troppo fastidio, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Na, was hältst du denn von diesem
Regenwetter?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nachts ist es gar
nicht so schlimm, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu yağmurla nasıl baş ediyorsun?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Gece
olunca o kadar kötü değil, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}You know, this late at night, the
sound of the rain is soothing,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
don't you think?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Not that I need soothing. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}My nerves
are just fine, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}thank you.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Cuando es tan tarde y hay tanto
silencio, escuchar la lluvia es muy
tranquilizador, ¿verdad?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Aunque yo no necesito
tranquilizarme. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mis nervios
están perfectamente,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} gracias.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}À cette heure de la nuit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} le son de la
pluie a tendance à m'endormir.
Comme une berceuse, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Enfin, je veux dire, quand je suis
chez moi. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je ne vais pas non plus
dormir dehors sous la pluie, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ça non.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sai, a quest'ora di notte la pioggia
è quasi rilassante.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Amo il picchiettio
dell'acqua sulle tegole del tetto.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Perché allora sono fuori casa, mi
chiedi? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ehm, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}bella domanda.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Nachts ist das Prasseln des Regens
doch sehr beruhigend,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} findest du
nicht?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Nicht, dass ich Beruhigung bräuchte.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich bin vollkommen ausgeglichen,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}klar? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Mit Nerven wie Drahtseilen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Biliyor musun, gecenin bu saatinde
yağmurun sesi huzur veriyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} sence
de öyle değil mi? {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Benim sakinleşmeye
ihtiyacım olduğundan değil. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Sinirlerim
gayet yerinde, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}teşekkürler.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's so peaceful taking a walk this
late on a rainy night.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Well, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}that is, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}until I just started
talking, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me encanta escuchar cómo
la lluvia rompe el silencio de
la noche. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Lo oyes?
Bueno, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}ahora me oyes a mí, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}claro,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}On dirait que ça te plaît de te
promener sous la pluie à cette
heure...
Fais attention à ne pas prendre
froid surtout, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ein Spaziergang in einer verregneten
Nacht hat was. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Da ist die Stadt
ruhig und friedlich.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Na ja, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}also, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}sie war ruhig, bevor
ich angefangen habe zu quasseln,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yağmurlu bir gecede bu saatte yürümek
ne kadar huzurlu.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Şey, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}yani, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}ben konuşmaya
başlayana kadar, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
